library.service.ts:133-140 calls storageRepository.watch(library.importPaths, ...) and lines 255-280 (LibrarySyncFiles job) stat each path via processEntity and call assetRepository.createAll.

docker.yml:119-135 logs in to ghcr.io and re-tags images there with buildx imagetools; lines 164-210 are the 'Build and Push ML' and 'Build and Push Server' jobs (packages: write) calling the reusable multi-runner-build workflow, where the push itself happens.
draft-release.yml:79-84 pushes the git tag and 86-111 runs build-mobile.yml with signing secrets; lines 162-183 run `gh release create --draft` attaching the compose files, example.env and *.apk.

docker-compose.yml:13-15 sets the immich-server service image to ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}, and server/Dockerfile:89-101 copies the pruned server, the web build and the CLI into the final image.

buildUploadTask (390-455) returns an UploadTask with httpRequestMethod POST, url '$serverEndpoint/assets' and fileField 'assetData'; the service enqueues it via enqueueBackgroundAll (background_downloader).

POST /assets is guarded by Permission.AssetUpload and runs FileUploadInterceptor (multer custom storage writing to getUploadFolder = upload/<user>/xx/yy and hashing sha1) before uploadAsset, which calls requireAccess + requireQuota, creates the asset with checksum/sha1File and queues JobName.AssetExtractMetadata (line 202).

queueAll (197-227) resolves each job's queue from its handler and calls BullMQ queue.add/addBulk; AssetExtractMetadata's handler is registered on QueueName.MetadataExtraction ('metadataExtraction') in metadata.service.ts:228.

handleMetadataExtraction reads exif tags (exiftool-vendored), dates, dimensions/file size and GPS, reverse-geocodes via mapRepository (geodata_places query in Postgres), then emits AssetMetadataExtracted; that event queues StorageTemplateMigrationSingle, whose onDone queues AssetGenerateThumbnails when source is upload/copy.

handleGenerateThumbnails calls generateImageThumbnails (sharp-backed generateThumbnail for preview + thumbnail, generateThumbhash) and stores the thumbhash; JobService.onDone then queues SmartSearch, AssetDetectFaces and Ocr and sends 'on_upload_success' (for Timeline/Archive assets).

Three separate jobs each send the Preview file to the ML repository's predict() (POST <url>/predict): encodeImage (CLIP), detectFaces (detection + recognition) and ocr; config defaults have clip, facialRecognition and ocr all enabled: true (config.dto.ts:670-686).

search.repository upsert (480-486) inserts into smart_search with on-conflict update; refreshFaces inserts new rows into asset_face and their embeddings into face_search, and each added face gets a FacialRecognition job (person.service 441-452).
loadNextPage calls searchSmart (imported from @immich/sdk) with language: $lang when the terms have query/queryAssetId and config.machineLearning.clip.enabled, otherwise searchAssets.
@Post('smart') calls service.searchSmart, which throws 'Smart search is not enabled' unless isSmartSearchEnabled and resolves userIds through getUserIdsToSearch(auth, dto.visibility).

resolveEmbedding builds the cache key modelName + query + language, and on a miss calls machineLearningRepository.encodeText (CLIP textual, POST /predict with a text form field, which main.py accepts).
searchSmart sets 'vchordrq.probes' (VectorChord), inner-joins smart_search, orders by smart_search.embedding <=> embedding, and applies limit size+1 / offset for one page via paginationHelper.
The response is destructured into { albums, assets }; albums.items and assets.items are pushed into searchResultAlbums/searchResultAssets and nextPage is taken from assets.nextPage.

handleDetectFaces returns Skipped when facial recognition is disabled or asset.visibility is Hidden (Failed if there is no preview), otherwise calls machineLearningRepository.detectFaces(previewFile.path, ...).

detectFaces requests the facial-recognition task with DETECTION and RECOGNITION models and returns faces (each consumed as { boundingBox, embedding }); the default model buffalo_l is in _INSIGHTFACE_MODELS (constants.py 70-75).
refreshFaces(facesToAdd, faceIdsToRemove, embeddings) saves faces and embeddings, then one FacialRecognition job per added face is queued (together with a FacialRecognitionQueueAll job).

searchFaces queries face_search within maxDistance for minFaces results; a core face (>= minFaces matches, Timeline asset) takes a match's personGroupId or creates a group, a non-core face is re-queued with deferred: true (nuance: a face that only matched itself is skipped outright, and a deferred face can still join the nearest existing person).

When no person exists for the group, a person is created and PersonGenerateThumbnail is queued; its handler uses previewPath for videos and originalPath otherwise (embedded RAW preview when extractEmbedded applies) and crops to the face box.
In onDone for AssetGenerateThumbnails, AssetEncodeVideo is pushed onto the follow-up jobs when asset.type === AssetType.Video (job.service.ts 182-184).

getTranscodeTarget(ffmpeg, ...) decides the target; TranscodeTarget.None with no remux needed returns Skipped; otherwise transcode runs and on failure retries with software decoding, then with acceleration disabled.

getEncodedVideoPath = getNestedPath(StorageFolder.EncodedVideo ('encoded-video'), ownerId, '<id>.mp4') which nests by filename[0:2]/[2:4]; after transcoding upsertFile records it as AssetFileType.EncodedVideo.
GET :id/video/playback (described as supporting byte range requests) sends service.playbackVideo, which returns asset.encodedVideoPath || asset.originalPath.

assetFileUrl is getAssetHlsUrl (…/video/stream/main.m3u8) when publicConfig.ffmpeg.realtime.enabled, else getAssetPlaybackUrl (/assets/:id/video/playback), or the original when playOriginalVideo is set; it is assigned to the video element's src.

The modal builds sharedLinkCreateDto with type Album when albumId is set plus password, expiresAt, allowUpload, allowDownload (also slug, description, showMetadata) and runs createSharedLinkMutation; the server has @Post() on @Controller('shared-links').
create() requires Permission.AlbumShare for album links and always sets key: cryptoRepository.randomBytes(50), with slug: dto.slug || null.
sharedLinkRepository.create inserts the link; handleError maps the 'shared_link_slug_uq' constraint violation to BadRequestException('Failed to save shared link').
loadSharedLink (used by the share/[key] and s/[slug] route loaders) calls getMySharedLink({ key, slug }) unless a matching cached link exists.
validateSharedLinkKey looks the key up with sharedLinkRepository.getByKey, rejects when there is no user or expiresAt is past, and returns AuthDto { user: sharedLink.user, sharedLink }.
Both GET :id/thumbnail and GET :id/video/playback are declared with @Authenticated({ permission: Permission.AssetView, sharedLink: true }).
Steps run 'mise //:release --type', commit 'chore: version ${VERSION}' and push, then (when run from main) push HEAD to refs/heads/release/v<major>.<minor>.

The tag job pushes the version tag from the release branch, build_mobile runs build-mobile.yml with signing secrets (artifact release-apk-signed), and 'gh release create --draft' attaches the docker compose files, example.env, hwaccel/prometheus files and *.apk.
docker.yml triggers on release types [published] (release is a force-event), and builds immich-server plus the ML matrix (cpu, cuda, openvino, armnn, rknn, rocm).

Tag rules include semver v{{version}}, v{{major}} and raw 'release' (non-prerelease, highest overall); the mirror job runs only for non-prerelease release events and copies ghcr.io tags to docker.io/altran1502.

docker-compose.yml uses image ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release} and example.env sets IMMICH_VERSION=v3; the pull/up -d upgrade command is in docs/docs/install/upgrading.md:16.
